rubric: Dependency-free Go CLI. The agent should add a [build.*] manifest target that go-builds the binary and installs it to $out/bin, then flox build must succeed and the binary must run.

Cargo project with clap/serde/tokio deps and no lockfile — cargo fetches from the network during the build. The agent should add a [build.*] target running cargo build --release and installing the binary to $out/bin. Watch for CARGO_TARGET_DIR interplay: the seeded dev env points it at $FLOX_ENV_CACHE.

Dependency-free Node CLI with a bin entry in package.json. The agent should add a [build.*] target that installs the script into $out/bin (executable, node on PATH via the environment). Tests the $out layout guidance for interpreted languages.

FastAPI app with a hatchling build backend and no console-script entry point — the hardest of the four on purpose. Any coherent artifact under $out (wheel, installed package tree) counts; a runnable bin is a bonus. Stretch tier: measures where the build guidance runs out, not a pass/fail bar.
